seniors.seated_version: Seated rhythmic leg extensions and torso stabilization.
seniors.standing_version: Supported standing kicks with reduced tempo.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo (110-120 BPM) and limited range of motion.

movement_profile.footwork: Fast kicks, rotational footwork, and jumps in time with the kick drum.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo, duo, or group; performed in clubs, parks, or online videos.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Stable torso with rotational movement originating from the hips and legs.
movement_profile.posture: Relatively stiff upper body with most movement concentrated in the legs.

signature_moves.description: Two dancers face each other and synchronize kicks.
signature_moves.name: Duo-kick

signature_moves.description: Rotational movements performed on the ground or in the air.
signature_moves.name: Spins

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Fast and rhythmic, matching the 140-160 BPM kick.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Unintentional physical contact with other dancers outside of the duo-kick.

music_profile.musical_form: Electronic dance music with hard house and hardstyle influences.
music_profile.sound_description: A high-tempo electronic sound defined by a heavy, repetitive 909 kick drum and melodic, distorted synthesizer leads.

teaching.level_notes: Beginners typically start with oldschool 5-touch steps before progressing to hardjump transitions.
teaching.rhythm: 4/4 time, synchronized with the 909 kick drum.
